title: The Cellar Door
journal: Never-Writes-Twice says Fort Chalkmoth is a fort like any other, but a wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in its cellar. This is my own errand, not the order's; the hunt waits at Bell Station and either may come first. Fort Chalkmoth is the Archwardens' fort on the Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara. I'm to get into the fort and see its cellar: the wall captain at the gate may let me in, or I may find another way in unseen.
objectives: Get into Fort Chalkmoth's keep, by the wall captain's leave or unseen. (marker: Sakeeus-Wan, Door to Fort Chalkmoth Guardroom)

plan.going: This is my own errand, to see what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth; the order's hunt, at Bell Station, is open beside it and either may come first.
plan.next: Get into Fort Chalkmoth's keep, on the mesa above Noota Nara.
plan.ways: Ask the wall captain at the gate for leave, or go in unseen by the trapdoor in the yard.

answers: I am on my own errand, not the order's: a wounded Unbound scout, Tah-Leesh, said to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth. Never-Writes-Twice dismissed it. The Bell Station hunt for the marked tower waits.
Get into Fort Chalkmoth keep and see its cellar, here at the fort on Chixathe Mesa.
Ask the wall captain Sakeeus-Wan for leave to enter, or find another way in unseen (the keep door is locked; there is a guardroom door). Three Sarpa Raiders are also here.
I do not know what the moaning in the cellar is, or why the Unbound care. I could find out by asking people here and seeing the cellar.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: The wall captain, Sakeeus-Wan, says a Toh-Wo may sleep in the barracks, but the keep stays shut to strangers while three Sarpa raiders rob the chalk carts on the western approach. I'm to kill the three raiders; then he will open the keep and pay me. I can still go in unseen by the trapdoor in the yard instead.
objectives: Kill the three Sarpa raiders on Fort Chalkmoth's western approach. (marker: Sarpa Raider, Sarpa Raider, Sarpa Raider)
Tell the wall captain the raiders are dead. (marker: Sakeeus-Wan)

plan.going: The captain will open the keep once the raiders on the western approach are dead.
plan.next: Kill the three Sarpa raiders, then tell the captain.
plan.ways: Fight the raiders (any weapon or magic), or skip the captain and go in by the trapdoor unseen.

answers: The wall captain Sakeeus-Wan will open the keep and pay 100 gold if I kill three Sarpa raiders robbing chalk carts on the western approach. I still work on my own errand to see the cellar.
Either kill the three raiders on the western approach and report back to Sakeeus-Wan, or take the alternative.
Kill the raiders for his leave and gold, or go in unseen by the trapdoor in the yard.
I do not know where the trapdoor is exactly or what it leads to; I can look around the yard. The old prison below the keep is the order's, which I do not fully understand.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: I came up through the trapdoor in the yard into the cellar's guardroom, unseen. If the garrison sees me in here, they will attack. The stair from the guardroom climbs to the quartermaster's store. I'm to see what I can of the cellar: the store above, the gaoler at the stair's foot and the inner door.
objectives: Look in the quartermaster's store at the top of the cellar stair. (marker: Jar of Hist Sap (Jal-Veesa Knot))
Speak to the gaoler at the foot of the cellar stair. (marker: Tsleel-Vaku)
Try the cellar door. (marker: Door to Cellar Door)

plan.going: I am inside unseen, in the guardroom below the keep. Being seen means a fight with the garrison.
plan.next: Three things, in any order: look in the store at the top of the stair, speak to the gaoler, try the cellar door.
plan.ways: Stay unseen; persuade the gaoler or test him with Illusion for more (optional).

answers: I got into the cellar guardroom unseen via the yard trapdoor. If the garrison sees me they attack. I am investigating what moans in the cellar, on my own errand.
Look at the quartermaster store above (a Jar of Hist Sap marker, Jal-Veesa Knot), speak to gaoler Tsleel-Vaku, and try the locked cellar door.
Talk to the gaoler, search the store, try the locked door (maybe pick it).
I do not know what the Jar of Hist Sap or Jal-Veesa Knot mean, or what is behind the cellar door; I can ask the gaoler and look at the jar.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: Jars of Hist sap marked with Jal-Veesa's knot are stacked by the cellar stair, in a fort with no Hist of its own. The order's gaoler turned me away from the inner door, Toh-Wo or not, and said Never-Writes-Twice keeps its key. Behind the door, something moans. Who is down there, and why the order feeds them sap, I cannot learn here. I'm to go back to the hunt for the three seal-stones.

plan.next: Go back to the hunt for the three seal-stones, already marked by MN13.

answers: The quest is done: the cellar behind the inner door holds something that moans; the order feeds them Hist sap in jars marked with the Jal-Veesa knot, though the fort has no Hist. The gaoler refused me and said Never-Writes-Twice keeps the key, which makes her dismissal suspicious.
Go back to the hunt for the seal-stones: Bell Station near Lilmoth for the marked tower.
Bell Station first, or confront Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom about the key and cellar.
I do not know who is down there, why they are fed sap, or who Jal-Veesa is; I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or look elsewhere.
